english.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the act of moving permanently to another country.

examples.traditional: 我考慮緊移民去加拿大。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 haau2 leoi6 gan2 ji4 man4 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6

english.note: Use this for someone who moves to another country or region to make a home there; it is the common spoken choice for that meaning.

english.meaning: person who settles in a new country
english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who moves to another country to settle there.

examples.english: My cousin became a settler in Canada.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 go1 ji4 man4 zo2 gaa1 naa4 daai6

examples.english: My cousin is an immigrant in Canada and now lives in Toronto.
examples.traditional: 我表哥移民咗加拿大，依家住喺多倫多。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 go1 ji4 man4 zo2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 ji1 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 do1 leon4 do1
